blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: While recent vision-language models (VLMs) have shown outstanding performance across diverse applications, they tend to under-use visual information and over-rely on textual context. In this work, we propose GeoPID , a training-free framework that analyzes multimodal information within VLMs from a geometric perspective. GeoPID decomposes information into Redundant, Modality-Unique, and Synergistic components through the geometric relationships between visual and textual representation subspaces. Through an extensive analysis across 22 VLMs and 14 benchmarks, we confirm that correct predictions exhibit stronger vision-unique components when questions strongly require visual grounding. Building on this geometric analysis, we introduce a targeted intervention technique that selectively amplifies visual representations along the vision-unique subspace during inference. As a result, visual grounding capabilities were enhanced without any additional model parameter updates, achieving an average relative accuracy gain of 7.63%.
blocks.zh: 虽然近期的视觉语言模型(VLMs)在各种应用中表现出了出色的性能,但它们往往对视觉信息使用不足,对文字上下文过于真实. 在这项工作中,我们提出GeoPID,这是一个无培训框架,从几何角度分析VLM内部的多式信息。 GeoPID通过视觉和文字表达子空间之间的几何关系将信息分解为Redundant,Modality-Unique,和Synergistic等元件. 通过对22个甚高分辨率和14个基准的广泛分析,我们确认,当问题非常需要视觉定位时,正确的预测显示出更强的视觉-独特成分。 在这个几何分析的基础上,我们采用了一种有针对性的干预技术,在推论中选择性地将视觉-独特子空间上的视觉表现放大. 因此,在没有任何附加模型参数更新的情况下,视觉地基能力得到增强,平均相对精度增益为7.63%.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs) enable joint grounding of visual and linguistic information, resulting in state-of-the-art performance across a wide range of practical applications. This includes visual question answering Zhang et al. (2024) , action understanding ( Kaviani et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2025 ) , medical image analysis ( Li et al., 2023b ) , and judging the quality of generated visual data ( Lin et al., 2024 ) . A core motivation behind VLMs is to combine visual and linguistic information, which can include both shared context and modality-specific details. Ideally, a model should use the visual information required by the question and combine it with textual instructions to produce an image-grounded answer. For example, in Figure 1 (c), both modalities establish the shared context of a bedroom, where the text expresses explicit praise while the image depicts clear disorder. Jointly processing these inputs reveals a mismatch between what is said and what is shown, which is essential for capturing the speaker’s sarcastic intent as shown in Figure 1 (d-2). However, VLMs often under-use visual information and over-rely on textual context ( Leng et al., 2024 ) . For example, in Figure 1 (d-1), the model interprets the text as genuine praise, missing the visual evidence needed to recognize the contradiction. This raises specific questions: do VLMs use visual information beyond what is already available from the text, and how is this information organized within their internal representations?
blocks.zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)的近期进步使得视觉和语言信息能够共同地定位,从而在广泛的实际应用中产生最先进的性能. 这包括视觉问题回答:张等 (2024),动作理解(Kaviani等,2025;Kim等,2025),医学影像分析(Li等,2023b),以及判断所生成视觉数据的质量(Lin等,2024). VLMs背后的一个核心动机是将视觉和语言信息结合起来,这可以包括共享上下文和特定模式的细节. 理想的情况是,一个模型应该使用问题所要求的视觉信息,并结合文字指令生成以图像为基础的答案. 例如,在图1(c)中,两种模式都确立了卧室的共同上下文,其中文字表达出明确的赞美,而图像则描绘出明显的混乱. 如图1(d-2)所示,联合处理这些投入表明,所说的话和所显示的内容不匹配,这对于反映发言者的讽刺意图至关重要。 然而,VLMs往往使用不足视觉信息,对文字上下文过于真实(Leng等,2024.). 例如,在图1 (d-1)中,模型将文本解释为真正的赞美,缺少了识别矛盾所需的视觉证据. 这就提出了具体问题:虚拟材料是否使用超出现有文本的可视信息,这种信息如何在内部表述中加以组织?

blocks.en: Figure 1: In this figure, we take a visual and textual input and project them into their own representation space (a-b), where vectors represent features that can be extracted from each input modality. (c): The fused representation space reveals geometric relationships and contrasting modality-specific content: text-unique features ( orange ) praise the room’s tidiness, while vision-unique features ( blue ) depict the disorder. The green direction denotes the complementary geometry in which synergy is evaluated. (d): Our approach selectively amplifies along the vision-unique subspace while preserving its orthogonal complement.
blocks.zh: 图1:在本图中,我们将一个视觉和文字输入投影到它们自己的表示空间(a-b)中,向量代表着可以从每个输入模式中取出的特点. (c) 连接的表示空间揭示出几何关系和不同模式的具体内容:文本独有的特征(橙色)称赞了房间的花纹,而视觉独有的特征(蓝色)则描绘了这种混乱。 绿色方向表示评价协同效应的互补几何. (d):我们的做法有选择地沿着视觉-独特子空间扩大,同时保持其正交互补。

blocks.en: Understanding how to leverage visual information, therefore requires distinguishing information shared with text, information unique to vision, and information available only through their combination. Partial Information Decomposition (PID) ( Williams and Beer, 2010 ) provides a framework for making these distinctions by decomposing the information that multiple modalities provide into three types: redundant information (R) , which is available in both vision and language; unique information (U) , which is provided exclusively by one modality; and synergistic information (S) , which becomes available only when the two modalities are considered jointly. Figure 1 illustrates these distinctions. Both modalities provide shared content (e.g., ‘room’, ‘desk’, ‘bed’) but they also contain contrasting unique content: in Figure 1 (b), the text characterizes the scene as tidy, spotless, and perfectly made, whereas the image in Figure 1 (a,c) provides image-specific details showing scattered clothes, a cluttered desk, and rumpled bedding. Recognizing the mismatch between the textual praise and the visual scene illustrates the role of synergistic information, supporting a sarcastic interpretation that neither modality establishes alone. Shared information alone may not be sufficient (Figure 1 (d-1)‘Before: praising the room’s tidiness’) as it misses the cross-modal relationship. The goal is therefore to distinguish these information components in VLMs, and use these distinctions to determine which visual components to selectively amplify to improve predictions.
blocks.zh: 因此,要了解如何利用视觉信息,就必须区分与文本共享的信息、视觉独有的信息以及仅通过组合获得的信息。 部分信息分解(PID)(Williams和Beer,2010年)提供了一个框架,通过将多种模式提供的信息分解成三种类型来实现这些区别:冗余信息(R),既以视觉也以语言提供;独有信息(U),完全由一种模式提供;协同信息(S),只有在联合考虑两种模式时才能提供. 图1说明了这些区别。 两种模式都提供共享内容(如 " 房间 " 、 " 办公桌 " 、 " 床 " 等),但它们也包含不同的独特内容:在图1(b)中,文本将场景描述为整洁、无斑点和完美地制作,而图1(a,c)中的图像则提供具体图像细节,显示零散的衣物、一叠的桌子和被褥。 认识到文字赞美与视觉场景的不匹配说明了协同信息的作用,支持一种讽刺性的解释,而这两种方式都不是单独确定的. 仅仅共享信息可能是不够的(图1(d-1) " 在:赞扬房间的花样 " 之前),因为它错过了跨模式的关系。 因此,目标是在VLMs中区分这些信息元件,并使用这些区分来确定哪些视觉元件有选择地被放大来改进预测.

blocks.en: Translating these distinctions into selective amplification presents two challenges. First, existing approaches quantify PID components using separate estimators, often based on predictions ( Fang et al., 2026 ; Liang et al., 2023b ) , but numerical PID values alone do not identify where shared and modality-specific information resides. Figure 1 illustrates this structure using 3D spheres to represent hidden representation spaces, with arrows corresponding to distinct features. Figure 1 (c) displays their geometric relationships in a fused space. Gray arrows denote shared features, orange arrows represent text-unique contents, and blue arrows isolate vision-unique details. Identifying these specific subspaces is important because it provides a target for selectively amplifying the vision-unique directions, as in Figure 1 (d). Second, improvements informed by multimodal information decomposition have primarily required costly additional training that is not practical in many application settings. Existing training-free methods for improving visual grounding at inference time instead rely on heuristic signals. This includes contrasting with distorted images ( Leng et al., 2024 ) , generating captions ( Li and Zhang, 2026 ) , or steering vectors ( Yin et al., 2026 ) , without explicitly decomposing shared, unique, and synergistic information to identify the intervention target.
blocks.zh: 将这些区别转化为选择性扩大提出了两个挑战。 首先,现有方法使用单独的估算器对PID成分进行量化,通常基于预测(Fang等,2026;Liang等,2023b),但仅数字PID值并不能确定共享和特定方式信息存在在何处。 图1用3D字段来说明这个结构来代表隐藏的表示空间,并有与不同特征相对应的箭头. 图1(c)显示它们在引信空间中的几何关系。 灰色箭头表示有共同的特征,橙色箭头代表文字上独一无二的内容,而蓝色箭头则隔离视觉上独一无二的细节. 如图1(d)所示,确定这些具体的子空间很重要,因为它为有选择地扩大独特的视觉方向提供了目标。 第二,从多式联运信息分解中得到的改进主要需要成本高昂的额外培训,而这种培训在许多应用环境中并不实际。 现有的无训练方法在推论时间改进视觉地基,取而代之的是热能信号. 这包括与被扭曲的图像(Leng等,2024年)作对比,生成标题(Li and Zhang等,2026年),或方向向量(Yin等,2026年),而没有明确分解共享,独特和协同的信息来识别干预目标.

blocks.en: To address these limitations, we propose GeoPID , a training-free framework for understanding and steering visual information use in VLMs. Our central idea is to characterize multimodal information through the geometric relationships between visual and textual representation subspaces. Intuitively, a modality’s representations can span directions that align with the other modality as well as directions that remain distinct. Based on this geometric perspective, we propose representation-based measures of PID components. To characterize geometric redundancy ( R ), we use the principal angles between the visual and textual representation subspaces to measure the extent to which the two modalities span shared directions. The unique visual and textual components, denoted by 𝐔 𝐯 \mathbf{U_{v}} and 𝐔 𝐭 \mathbf{U_{t}} , are associated with modality-specific directions orthogonal to the other modality’s estimated subspace. For synergy ( S ), we use the geometry outside the principal span of the combined visual and textual representations as the space in which to measure answer-related information. However, information in this space does not necessarily come from combining corresponding visual and textual inputs. We therefore project decision representations onto this complementary space and define our synergy measure as the difference in mutual information between these projected representations and answer labels under matched and mismatched image–text pairs. By connecting information decomposition to representation geometry, GeoPID provides both an analytical description of visual information and a concrete subspace target for intervention.
blocks.zh: 为了克服这些局限性,我们提议建立无培训框架GeoPID,以了解和指导视频信息在VLM中的使用。 我们的中心思想是通过视觉和文字代表子空间之间的几何关系来描述多式信息。 直觉上,一种模式的表述可以跨越与其他模式一致的方向以及仍然不同的方向。 基于这一几何角度,我们提出了基于代表的PID组件计量. 为了描述几何冗余(R),我们利用视觉和文字表示子空间之间的主要角度来衡量两种模式跨越共同方向的程度。 由 U v\ mathbf{ U_{v}} 和 Ut\mathbf{ U_{t}} 所表示出的独特视觉和文字组件,与模式特定方向正统地连接到其他模式的估计子空间. 关于协同作用(S.),我们利用综合视觉和文字表达的主要范围以外的几何作为衡量与回答有关的信息的空间。 然而,这一空间中的信息不一定来自相应的视觉和文字输入的结合. 因此,我们计划在这个互补空间上作出决策,并把我们的协同措施定义为这些预测的表述和答案标签在匹配和不匹配的图像-文本对下之间的相互信息差异。 GeoPID通过将信息分解与表达几何连接,既提供了视觉信息的分析描述,又提供了具体的子空间目标进行干预.

blocks.en: We apply GeoPID to 14 14 vision-language benchmarks across 22 22 models and identify three patterns. First, shared geometric structure develops across early and intermediate layers, while models exhibit different modality-specific profiles in later layers. This indicates that shared structure alone does not establish whether visual information is effectively used. Second, the information components vary with what is needed to answer each question: visual-grounding questions exhibit the highest 𝐔 𝐯 \mathbf{U_{v}} , while questions requiring visual grounding and the combination of text and image exhibit higher S . Third, for questions requiring vision information, correct answers exhibit stronger vision-unique components in the representation than incorrect answers. This suggests that strengthening representation components along vision-unique directions may help the model answer visually demanding questions. We therefore test a training-free intervention that selectively amplifies vision-token representation components along the identified vision-unique subspace. As illustrated in Figure 1 (c), this intervention strengthens image-specific components while preserving the remaining representation components, allowing subsequent layers to integrate the amplified visual content into the prediction. Our intervention yields an average relative accuracy gain of 7.63%, with qualitative examples further illustrating improved visual grounding in open-ended generation. Our contributions are as follows: 1. We present a geometric PID framework that characterizes shared and modality-specific representation subspaces and connects their structure to target-related information in VLMs. 2. We analyze how geometric structure and associated information evolve across layers and vary with the information required by a question, providing insight into visual information use, and motivating a vision-unique intervention target. 3. We develop a training-free intervention that selectively amplifies representation components along the identified vision-unique directions and evaluate its effectiveness across 14 14 benchmarks and 22 22 VLMs.
blocks.zh: 我们将GeoPID应用于22个模型的14个远景语言基准,并确定了三种模式。 首先,共享几何结构跨越早期地层和中间地层发展出,而模型则在后地层中展现出不同的模式特有剖面. 这表明仅共享结构并不能确定视觉信息是否得到有效利用. 第二,信息组件随回答每个问题需要什么而不同:视觉定位问题显示最高的U v\mathbf{U_{v}};而需要视觉定位和文本与图像组合的问题显示最高的S. 第三,对于需要视觉信息的问题,正确答案在表述中显示出比不正确答案更强有力的视觉独特组成部分。 这表明,沿着独特的愿景方向加强代表性部分可能有助于模型回答视觉要求高的问题。 因此,我们试验一种无培训的干预措施,它有选择地在已查明的视距独特的子空间上扩大视距代表部分。 如图1(c)所示,这种干预加强了图像特定组件,同时保留了其余的表示组件,使后几层能够将放大的视觉内容融入到预测中. 我们的干预平均获得7.63%的相对准确率,质量实例进一步说明在无限制一代人中视觉基础的改善。 我们的捐款如下: 1. 我们提出一个几何PID框架,其特征是共享和特定模式的表示子空间,并将其结构与VLM中的目标相关信息相连接。 2. 我们分析几何结构和相关的信息如何分层演变,并随着问题所需信息的不同而变化,提供视觉信息使用方面的洞察力,并激励一个视觉独特的干预目标。 3. 我们制定无培训的干预措施,有选择地按照既定的愿景-独特方向扩大代表性部分,并评价其效力,涵盖14个基准和22个甚高频。

blocks.en: Related Works. Partial Information Decomposition (PID) separates multimodal contributions into redundant, unique, and synergistic components ( Williams and Beer, 2010 ) . While recent works apply PID to VLMs for diagnosis and fine-tuning, they typically rely on separate estimators or require costly retraining ( Liang et al., 2023b ; Fang et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) . We instead compute these components directly from representation geometry, advancing beyond overall matrix rank measures ( Kim et al., 2026a ; Chaudhuri et al., 2025 ) to explicitly distinguish shared from modality-specific subspaces. Furthermore, existing training-free interventions mitigate visual hallucinations through heuristic methods ( Leng et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024a ) . GeoPID differs by explicitly utilizing this geometric PID to identify and selectively amplify the vision-unique subspace during inference, providing a theoretically grounded target rather than relying on heuristics. A comprehensive review of related literature is provided in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 相关作品. 部分信息分解(PID)将多模式贡献分为冗余、独特和协同部分(Williams and Beer, 2010.)。 虽然近期的作品将PID应用于VLM进行诊断和微调,但它们通常依赖单独的估计器或需要昂贵的再培训(梁等,2023b; Fang等, 2026; Wu等, 2026). 我们直接从表示几何计算这些成分,超越总体矩阵分级度量(Kim等,2026a;Chaudhuri等,2025年),以明确区分共享和模式特定子空间。 此外,现有的无培训干预措施通过高压方法减轻视觉幻觉(Leng等人,2024;Liu等人,2024a)。 GeoPID不同之处在于,在推论中明确使用这种几何PID来识别并有选择地扩展视觉-独有子空间,提供了一个理论上基于目标,而不是依赖休克. 附录B载有对有关文献的全面审查。

blocks.en: 2 Methodology
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: In this section, we address two complementary components. First, we analyze the geometry formed by vision and text tokens in the hidden representation and define four geometric PID components corresponding to redundancy, modality-specific uniqueness, and synergy. Second, we use the resulting vision-unique subspace as an intervention target and selectively amplify visual representation components along that subspace during inference.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们讨论两个相辅相成的组成部分。 首先,我们分析隐藏代表物中由视觉和文字符号所形成的几何,并定义了四个几何PID元件,对应冗余,模式特异性,协同效应. 第二,我们在推论中将由此产生的视觉独特子空间作为干预目标,并有选择地扩大该子空间沿线的视觉表现成分。

blocks.en: 2.1 Characterizing Multimodal Information
blocks.zh: 2.1 定性多式联运信息

blocks.en: Given a reference batch ℬ \mathcal{B} containing N ℬ N_{\mathcal{B}} image-text samples, let V i ∈ ℝ n i v × d , T i ∈ ℝ n i t × d V_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{n_{i}^{v}\times d},T_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{n_{i}^{t}\times d} denote the matrices obtained by stacking the vision- and text- token representations of sample i i , respectively. Here, n i v , n i t n_{i}^{v},n_{i}^{t} denote the number of vision and text tokens in sample i i , and d d is the hidden dimension. Let h i ∈ ℝ d h_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{d} denote the representation of the last input token, and stacking these representations gives H = [ h 1 ​ … ​ h N ℬ ] T ∈ ℝ N ℬ × d H=\begin{bmatrix}h_{1}\dots h_{N_{\mathcal{B}}}\end{bmatrix}^{T}\in\mathbb{R}^{N_{\mathcal{B}}\times d} .

We start from the observation that vision- and text- representations do not necessarily occupy the same directions, even when they reside in a shared d d -dimensional hidden space. A direction refers to a feature axis within this space. As illustrated by the arrows in Figure 1 (c), some directions may be expressed by both modalities, whereas others are predominantly occupied by only one modality. Based on this structure, we define four geometric bases to formalize these multi-modal relationships: • G R G_{R} : The geometry shared by vision and text, as shown in the gray directions in Figure 1 (c). • G U V G_{U_{V}} : The vision geometry orthogonal to the estimated text subspace. This is illustrated as the blue directions in Figure 1 (c). • G U t G_{U_{t}} : The text geometry orthogonal to the estimated vision subspace. This is illustrated as the orange directions in Figure 1 (c). • G S G_{S} : The geometry outside the principal span jointly estimated from the vision and text representations. This is illustrated as the green directions in Figure 1 (c).

blocks.en: We estimate geometric PID in two stages. blocks.en: To investigate this, we categorize the evaluation questions into four distinct types based on their evidence requirements by utilizing a LLM annotator (Claude Opus 5 ( Anthropic, 2026 ) ) to ensure objective categorization (detailed in Appendix D ). Text-sufficient ( T ) questions can be answered confidently using only the provided text and prior knowledge. Text-prior ( 𝐓 − \mathbf{T^{-}} ) questions contain textual clues that strongly suggest an answer, though the image remains necessary for certainty. Visual-observation ( V ) questions require direct inspection of the image content, such as object identification or counting. Lastly, Joint-evidence ( J ) questions mandate synthesizing substantive textual premises with visual observations to deduce the answer. In Table 3 , comparing the U V U_{V} column, V exhibits the highest value ( 1.34 1.34 ). Geometrically, U V U_{V} captures purely visual features that are independent of the text. This shows that when a question requires visual grounding (i.e., question type V ), the model correctly relies on this unique visual evidence. In the S S column, both V and J exceed T ( 3.56 3.56 and 3.55 3.55 , versus 2.24 2.24 ). Geometrically, S S measures the joint information existing outside the isolated vision and text spaces. These high scores for both V and J demonstrate that visual grounding actively drives cross-modal interaction. Appendix E.6 further shows that S S correlates with models’ use of visual information. Overall, these patterns suggest that the PID components measured by GeoPID reflect whether answering a question requires textual information, visual information, or both, connecting representation geometry to the information the task requires.

blocks.en: We apply the intervention Eq. 11 to amplify representation components along the vision-unique subspace and evaluate whether this improves predictions. For each of the 308 model × \times dataset pairs, we reserve 100 questions as a calibration subset, disjoint from the final evaluation set. We use the ground-truth labels of these 100 questions to select the ℓ ∗ / L ∈ [ 0.3 , 0.8 ] \ell^{*}/L\in[0.3,0.8] and α ∈ 1 , 2 , 4 , 6 , 8 , 12 \alpha\in{1,2,4,6,8,12} by maximizing calibration accuracy. The selected ( ℓ ∗ , α \ell^{*},\alpha ) is then fixed and applied to the full evaluation set without further tuning or label-dependent selection. Table 2 reports the resulting accuracy gains, yielding an average relative improvement of 7.63%. This shows that the subspace identified by the analysis can serve as an effective intervention target without updating model parameters. Table 4 reports accuracy before and after intervention for the four question types. The largest improvement occurs for questions requiring textual and visual information jointly ( J ). This is consistent with Figure 3 : strengthening vision-unique components can help when the model must use visual observations, or must combine visual with textual information. Moreover, positive gains for T and 𝐓 − \mathbf{T^{-}} also show that gains are not confined to the visually demanding questions alone.

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion

blocks.en: We present a framework to geometrically analyze and steer how VLMs distribute and utilize multimodal information via GeoPID . Specifically, adjusting the depth and strength of the intervention based on early shared geometry and text dominance leads to consistent gains across diverse benchmarks. Ultimately, our intervention shows that appropriately configured subspace manipulation can reliably enhance model performance. This framework provides a useful tool for analyzing multimodal representation spaces and addressing reasoning bottlenecks without costly retraining.

blocks.en: B.1 Analyzing multimodal interaction with PID
blocks.zh: B.1 分析与PID的多式互动

blocks.en: Partial Information Decomposition (PID) ( Williams and Beer, 2010 ) splits the information that two modalities provide about a task into redundant, unique, and synergistic parts. A line of work develops estimators for these quantities, from unique information definitions ( Bertschinger et al., 2014 ) and dedicated PID solvers ( Makkeh et al., 2018 ) to neural mutual-information estimators ( Belghazi et al., 2018 ; Oord et al., 2018 ) . Building on these, Liang et al. (2023b) ; Liang et al. (2023a) proposed scalable estimators that quantify multi-modal datasets and models from this perspective. The framework was then moved to use MLLMs ( Fang et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) . These works either decompose the modality contributions at the decision level ( Fang et al., 2026 ) , extend the PID decomposition layer by layer ( Wu et al., 2026 ) , or profile the information spectrum across 26 large VLMs ( Xiu et al., 2026 ) . Beyond diagnosis, several works attempt an intervention, either by teacher-student distillation ( Liang, 2025 ) , or by fine-tuning with PID-guided reweighting ( Fang et al., 2026 ) . However, these approaches share two limitations. First, they need a separate estimator to obtain the PID components, whose output is only approximate for continuous, high-dimensional representations. Second, any improvements they report are obtained through additional training. Unlike these, we read the information directly from the representation matrices via their rank, without assuming any distribution. We further turn the resulting diagnosis into a performance gain through a training-free intervention.
blocks.zh: 部分信息分解(PID)(Williams和Beer,2010年)将两种模式提供的关于任务的信息分为冗余,独特和协同的部分. 从独特的信息定义(Bertschinger等,2014年)和专用的PID解析器(Makkeh等,2018年)到神经相互信息估计器(Belghazi等,2018年;Oord等,2018年),为这些数量开发了一套估算器。 在此基础上,Liang等人(2023年b); 梁等 (2023a)提出了从这个角度量化多模式数据集和模型的可扩展估计器. 随后框架被移动至使用MLLMs(Fang等,2026;Wu等,2026.). 这些工作要么在决策层面分解模式贡献(Fang等,2026年),将PID分解层分层分层分层分解(Wu等,2026年),要么在26个大型VLM中剖析信息谱(Xiu等,2026年)。 除了诊断外,还有多部作品试图通过师生分馏(Liang, 2025年)或通过微调PID制导再加权(Fang等, 2026年)进行干预. 然而,这些办法有两个共同的限制。 首先,它们需要一个单独的估计器来得到PID组件,其输出仅用于连续的高维表示. 第二,他们报告的任何改进都通过额外培训获得。 与这些不同的是,我们直接从代表矩阵中通过它们的级别阅读信息,而不假定任何分布. 我们进一步通过无培训干预,将由此产生的诊断转化为业绩收益。

blocks.en: B.2 Representation Geometry and Information Measurement
blocks.zh: B.2 代表几何和信息测量

blocks.en: The rank of a representation, i.e., how many independent directions it spans, has been used as a measure of a matrix’s information content and representational diversity ( Roy and Vetterli, 2007 ; Rényi, 1961 ; Kokilepersaud et al., 2025a ; Kokilepersaud et al., 2025b ) . Recent multi-modal fusion work uses it to diagnose modality contributions and modality collapse ( Kim et al., 2026a ; Chaudhuri et al., 2025 ; Yarici and AlRegib, 2026 ) . These works treat every direction as equally useful and simply raise the total rank of the representation. However, the overall rank does not distinguish directions shared across modalities from those specific to each modality. We identify shared and modality-specific subspaces through the geometric relationships between visual and textual representations, and measure the answer-related information associated with these subspaces. This analysis identifies vision-unique directions as candidates for selective amplification.
blocks.zh: 代表的级别,即它跨越多少独立方向,被用作衡量矩阵信息内容和代表多样性的标准(Roy and Vetterli,2007;Rényi,2007. Kokilepersaud等人,2025年a;Kokilepersaud等人,2025年b) 最近的多模式聚变工作用它来诊断模式的贡献和模式崩溃(Kim等人,2026a;Chaudhuri等人,2025;Yarici和AlRegib,2026)。 这些作品将每个方向都视为同样有用的,只是提高了代表的总级别. 然而,总的级别并不区分不同方式之间的共同方向和每种方式的具体方向。 我们通过视觉和文字表达的几何关系,确定共享的和模式特定的子空间,并测量与这些子空间相关的解答相关信息. 本分析确定视向独特方向为选择性放大的候选对象.

blocks.en: B.3 Training-free Interventions for Visual Information Use
blocks.zh: B.3 视觉信息使用的免费培训干预措施

blocks.en: A large body of work reduces VLM hallucination in a training-free manner. These methods either contrast the logits of a removed visual input to amplify the vision contribution (contrastive decoding) ( Leng et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025b ) , shift activations toward visual-perception directions ( Liu et al., 2024a ; Yin et al., 2026 ) , intervene at the token level ( Li and Zhang, 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025a ) , or adjust the information flow ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; Mao et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Kim et al., 2026b ) . However, these methods do not explicitly use PID to identify the intervention target. In contrast, our approach uses geometric PID analysis to identify a vision-unique subspace and selectively amplifies visual representation components along vision-unique subspace during inference.
blocks.zh: 大量工作以无培训方式减少VLM幻觉. 这些方法或者与去除的视觉输入的对数对比,以扩大视觉贡献(连续解码)(Leng等人,2024年;Chen等人,2025年b),将活化转向视觉-感知方向。 (刘等,2024a; Yin等,2026年),以象征性方式干预(李和章,2026年;王等,2025年a),或调整信息流(刘等,2026年;赵等,2025年;毛等,2026年;王等,2025年b;金等,2026年b.). 然而,这些方法没有明确使用PID来确定干预目标. 相比之下,我们的方法使用几何PID分析来确定一个视觉-独特子空间,并在推论中沿着视觉-独特子空间选择性地放大视觉表现元件.

blocks.en: Section 2.1 defines S S as the difference in answer information measured within G S G_{S} between matched and mismatched image–text inputs. To examine whether this difference depends on replacing the image with one from another category, we compare matched images, same-category substitutes, different-category substitutes, and blank inputs. Table 12 reports three examples. For InternVL3-8B ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) on MMBench ( Liu et al., 2024b ) , answer information within G S G_{S} falls from 0.4150 0.4150 with the matched image to 0.0323 0.0323 with a same-category substitute, close to 0.0274 0.0274 with a different-category substitute. The other two examples show the same pattern. Thus, the reduction occurs even when the substitute preserves the image category. This supports interpreting S S as sensitive to the specific image-text correspondence, rather than attributing the reduction solely to a change in image category or the removal of visual input.

blocks.en: To identify patterns that guide our intervention settings, we analyze the relationship between the base models’ geometric profiles and the resulting accuracy gains. Table 18 presents the correlations across all 308 model-benchmark combinations. We observe that individual geometric shifts, such as a lower baseline synergy S S , a larger late-layer decline in shared geometry ( Δ ​ G R \Delta G_{R} ), and a late-layer rise in text-unique geometry, are moderately predictive of intervention benefits. To assess the combined predictive power of these profiles, we fit gradient-boosted tree regressors ( Friedman, 2001 ) using 10-fold cross-validation. While combining static layer differences yields a Pearson correlation of 0.66 0.66 , incorporating the full layer-wise trajectories of G R G_{R} , G U t G_{U_{t}} , G U v G_{U_{v}} , and S S across all layers increases the correlation to r = 0.80 r=0.80 . This strong predictive relationship demonstrates that the layer-wise evolution of representation geometry reliably indicates the potential benefit of vision-unique amplification, directly motivating the geometry-based intervention rules applied in Section 3.2 .

blocks.en: The effectiveness of GeoPID extends beyond multiple-choice evaluation to open-ended visual question answering. As illustrated in Figure 8 , baseline VLMs frequently rely on language priors or exhibit text-biased hallucinations when generating free-form text. For instance, when asked to identify the green items placed on the ground that will eventually turn yellow, the baseline model incorrectly guesses “corn” rather than grounding its answer in the visual evidence of unripe bananas. Similarly, it defaults to generic or stereotypical predictions like “talking” or “chihuahua” instead of accurately identifying the man singing on the TV or the German Shepherd on the boat. By selectively amplifying the vision-unique subspace ( G U v G_{U_{v}} ), GeoPID effectively overrides these misleading text priors, enabling the model to generate accurate, visually grounded responses in open-ended settings.
